facts.fact: CIA 在入职第一天就发给你化名，喜不喜欢都得认。
facts.anchor: They gave you your Funny Name on Day One, and like it or not you were stuck.

facts.fact: 这台 ENIAC 占了三间中号房间，一直干得不错，直到被拔掉电源那天。
facts.anchor: The ENIAC filled three medium-sized rooms, and it did a pretty good job, that is until the day somebody unplugged it.

facts.fact: 1963 年，The Pseudo Guy 的入职申请被 CIA 安全办公室的某个硬汉驳回。
facts.anchor: His application had been rejected by some hardass from CIA’s Office of Security back in 1963

facts.fact: 他某晚伪装成“不起眼的清洁女工”溜进 CIA 总部大院。
facts.anchor: he snuck onto the CIA Headquarters compound one evening disguised as a Nondescript Cleaning Lady

facts.fact: 他完成的第一个化名是 Jane O. THORNE，随后又给自己起了 John O. THORNE。
facts.anchor: his first completed Funny Name lay before him. Jane O. THORNE.

facts.fact: 分析师们立下秘密血盟，只以“The One”称呼他。
facts.anchor: they agreed to refer to him only as “The One.”

facts.fact: 他的低迷期落在 1975 至 1981 年，后来被称为“Less-Than-Stellar Middle Period”。
facts.anchor: It fell during 1975 to 1981, in what later came to be known as his “Less-Than-Stellar Middle Period.”

facts.fact: KRAY 拥有一个完整句式的化名，这让他自动获得初级官员的某种地位。
